message:
Make Duality Upgrade 25 match the Hadron pane's Dark Hadron cap

The requirement checked 5 raw hours of the Endgame and ignored the
Hadron speed bonus and empowerment cap, so the Hadrons pane could show
Dark Hadrons as capped while the upgrade stayed locked. Both now use
Hadrons.darkEmpowermentHours, and the requirement shows live progress:
Dark Hadron count, empowerment percentage and time left.
